verdict.summary: The new wire branch remains fail-closed for absent, unknown, missing-predicate, and invalid-IRI scopes, and reconstructs a deterministic shape whose labels and triple order match the signed certification preimage. The end-to-end grant test exercises the real HTTP decision path with an independently reconstructed, certifier-signed shape; the companion denial test demonstrates that the scope is neither ignored nor widened. This is consistent with the trust semantics' attenuation-only rule and the public HTTP-surface documentation is updated. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect in the diff. Targeted execution could not be performed because cargo is unavailable in the review environment.
